text:
Tess (Growth): Hey team — quick design request for the next webinar push. Need a compact "launch packet": 1 hero benchmark card (web + print), 2 slide templates (data + routing), and 2 social tiles. Deadline: next Wed EOD.
Ravi (Design): Got it. Specs? sizes, color treatments, filetypes?
Tess (Growth): Hero: 1000x600 PNG + SVG. Print card: 4x6 PDF (bleed). Slides: 16:9 Figma templates. Social: 1200x1200 and 1080x1920 story. Include an accessibility colorway.
Asha (Creative Ops): Metrics to surface: p50 latency (typical seq), throughput (tokens/sec), cost per 1k tokens (hosted vs dedicated), and "cache delta" as a callout. Only use numbers from the eval sheet I shared.
Marco (Content): Headline options: "Serving that scales" / "Inference that actually saves" / "Real benchmarks, real tradeoffs". Which tone?
Tess (Growth): Engineer-forward but clear for sales. Pick option 2 and shorten: "Inference that saves."
Ravi (Design): Will set up Figma file and pull token legend from design-system. Figma link when ready. Any routing requirements?
Asha (Creative Ops): Yes — routing diagram should show: register -> email nurture -> demo-op queue. Add a conditional block: "score>75 -> SDR follow-up" (placeholder). Also include HubSpot mapping as hidden fields.
Tess (Growth): HubSpot snippet to paste into figma notes:
```
utm_source=serving_launch
utm_campaign=serving_apr
hidden_field=campaign_source
```
FigmaBot: https://www.figma.com/file/unique/serving-launch-packet  comment access enabled.
Ravi (Design): Quick Qs: 1) Legal footnote placement? 2) Do we want a micro-animated sparkline for the web hero?
LegalBot: Any quantitative claim needs a source line with the eval doc link and test date in small type. Avoid superlatives or competitor mentions.
Tess (Growth): Footnote on every asset: "Source: Redwood internal evals — Mar 2026". Animation is nice-to-have; ship static first.
Marco (Content): I'll draft micro-copy for the cards and alt-text for socials. Short CTA: "Register" / "Request demo".
Asha (Creative Ops): Timeline: initial comps Mon AM, internal review Tue, legal check Wed morning, final Wed EOD. Sound doable?
Ravi (Design): Yep. I'll push initial frames to Figma today. Tagging Marco for copy.
Tess (Growth): Also include a small placeholder on slides to call out recommended levers: batching, KV caching, dedicated pools. Use phrasing "recommended" not "supported".
Asha (Creative Ops): Noted. I'll create the Asana task and add localization flags for later.
Ravi (Design): Pushed a starter file — dropping link. Will iter on color variants and make sure contrast passes. :hammer_and_wrench:
FigmaBot: https://www.figma.com/file/unique/serving-launch-packet?node-id=10:5  frames uploaded.
Tess (Growth): Thanks — I'll post the eval link in #private-docs and tag the rows to cite. Please don't guess numbers.
Marco (Content): Draft copies in Figma notes. Will iterate after design frames.
LegalBot: I'll review the small-type claims after upload; expect a 4-6 hour turnaround.
Asha (Creative Ops): Great work. Everyone, confirm in-thread when you upload final assets so I can route to socials and sales. :white_check_mark:
